subtitle: Lesson 20 · Working With Real IBM Quantum Hardware

eyebrow: Connecting and finding the quietest device
code:
from qiskit_ibm_runtime import QiskitRuntimeService

service = QiskitRuntimeService(channel="ibm_quantum_platform")
backend = service.least_busy(operational=True, simulator=False)
print(backend.name, backend.num_qubits)
caption: least_busy filters out offline devices and cloud simulators, and returns whichever real backend has the shortest queue right now.
